diagnostics.message: google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service attaches this project as a Shared VPC service project, which requires the Compute Engine API to be enabled in the service project first. Unlike the host-side resources (shared_vpc_host -> service_projects) which chain to google_project_service.project_services, shared_vpc_service has no attribute reference or depends_on to project_services, so nothing guarantees the Compute Engine API is enabled before the attachment. Add depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services].
